neighbours.label: ' Joe' completing the franchise name 'G.I. Joe' / 'GI Joe'
fire: My brother kept every G.I. Joe figure he ever owned.
The studio announced another live-action G.I. Joe sequel.
We spent whole summers staging battles with GI Joe soldiers.
A rare G.I. Joe vehicle sold for thousands at auction.
The cartoon version of G.I. Joe aired every weekday afternoon.
He still has the GI Joe lunchbox from second grade.
Collectors argue about which G.I. Joe line was the best.
The museum display featured vintage GI Joe packaging.
quiet: My brother kept every Star Wars figure he ever owned.
The studio announced another live-action Transformers sequel.
We spent whole summers staging battles with plastic army soldiers.
A rare Hot Wheels vehicle sold for thousands at auction.
The cartoon version of He-Man aired every weekday afternoon.
He still has the lunchbox his friend Joe gave him in second grade.
Collectors argue about which Lego line was the best.
The museum display featured vintage Barbie packaging.

notes: Probe: G.I. Joe 0.96, GI Joe 0.59, 'uncle Joe' 0.17, 'Joe Biden' 0.02; other top examples (Ouabache, oauth2client, LOUIS-CÉSAIRE) suggest a broader 'last piece of a fixed multi-part name' that this test does not claim. Near misses keep the toy/film topic or use Joe as a plain first name.
